reference.note: The original user-owned file is labeled 18567.png but is actually JPEG-encoded. Preserve exact SHA-256-bound original bytes; do not silently transcode.

rules.evidence: exact source png + exact 9-material candidate GLB + actual native Godot 4K PNGs at five distinct cameras + source-bound sha audit

reviewer_rule: Separate C1 fidelity + C2 integrity visual reviewer must inspect original full-resolution owner source and true rendered Godot pixels, not only textual descriptions or offline Blender previews. The reviewer cannot be the candidate builder. Record raw reviewer output and independently-run provenance.
acceptance_note: A score >=9.5 for all non-style visual dimensions and exact 10 for fidelity/style is a critic milestone, NOT a substitute for actual-game/physical-Android performance, C6 or explicit owner approval. A single low axis rejects the candidate.
privacy: Build package locally from private user reference, keep private artifact outside public GitHub. GitHub workflows may test the critic validator with synthetic fixtures; do not upload 18567.png or private critic source boards to the repo.
